title: Naturalization application (Form N-400): documents needed
use_when: The client is a lawful permanent resident applying for U.S. citizenship on Form N-400.
note: Based on the USCIS Document Checklist, Form M-477 (Rev. 11/21/2016), the edition USCIS still publishes; it is older than the current N-400 form, so check it against the current form instructions. The responsible lawyer decides what the matter needs.

m477.name: USCIS, Form M-477, Document Checklist (for Form N-400), Rev. 11/21/2016

situations.resides-abroad: Does the applicant live outside the United States?
situations.name-change: Is the applicant's current legal name different from the name on the Permanent Resident Card?
situations.marriage-to-citizen: Is the applicant applying on the basis of marriage to a U.S. citizen?
situations.military: Is the applicant currently in U.S. military service and seeking citizenship based on that service?
situations.long-trip: Has the applicant taken any trip outside the United States that lasted 6 months or more since becoming a permanent resident?
situations.dependents-apart: Does the applicant have a dependent spouse or children who do not live with the applicant?
situations.arrest-no-charges: Has the applicant ever been arrested or detained by any law enforcement officer where no charges were filed?
situations.arrest-charges: Has the applicant ever been arrested or detained where charges were filed?
situations.conviction: Has the applicant ever been convicted or placed in an alternative sentencing or rehabilitative program?
situations.record-cleared: Has any arrest or conviction been vacated, set aside, sealed, expunged or otherwise removed from the record?
situations.tax-not-filed: Has the applicant ever failed to file an income tax return since becoming a permanent resident?
situations.taxes-overdue: Does the applicant have any federal, state or local taxes that are overdue?
situations.disability-exception: Is the applicant applying for a disability exception to the testing requirement?
situations.selective-service: Is the applicant a male, 26 or older, who did not register with the Selective Service and lived in the United States between ages 18 and 26 in a status other than lawful nonimmigrant?

items.label: Photocopy of both sides of the Permanent Resident Card (green card)
items.detail: If the card is lost, a photocopy of the receipt of Form I-90, Application to Replace Permanent Resident Card. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: 2 identical color photographs
items.detail: Name and Alien Registration Number (A-Number) written lightly in pencil on the back of each photo. Required if the applicant resides outside the United States.

items.label: The document(s) that legally changed the applicant's name
items.detail: Marriage certificate, divorce decree, or court document.

items.label: Evidence the spouse has been a U.S. citizen for the last 3 years
items.detail: One of: birth certificate (if the spouse never lost citizenship since birth); Certificate of Naturalization; Certificate of Citizenship; the inside of the front cover and signature page of the spouse's current U.S. passport; or Form FS-240, Report of Birth Abroad of a Citizen of the United States of America. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Current marriage certificate
Proof of termination of all prior marriages of the spouse
items.detail: Divorce decree(s), annulment(s), or death certificate(s).

items.label: Documents referring to the applicant and the spouse
items.detail: One of: tax returns, bank accounts, leases, mortgages, or birth certificates of children; IRS-certified copies of the income tax forms both filed for the past 3 years; or an IRS tax return transcript for the last 3 years. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Proof that all the applicant's earlier marriages ended
items.detail: Divorce decree(s), annulment(s), or death certificate(s).

items.label: Any court or government order to provide financial support
Evidence of financial support for the dependents
items.detail: Including evidence of compliance with any court or government order, such as: cancelled checks; money and receipts; a court or agency printout of child support payments; evidence of wage garnishments; a letter from the parent or guardian who cares for the children.

items.label: Completed original Form N-426, Request for Certification of Military or Naval Service
IRS tax return transcript or IRS-certified tax return for the last 5 years
items.detail: For the last 3 years if applying on the basis of marriage to a U.S. citizen. Evidence that the applicant (and family) continued to live, work and/or keep ties to the United States.

items.label: Rent or mortgage payments and pay stubs
Original official statement confirming that no charges were filed
items.detail: By the arresting agency or applicable court.

items.label: Complete arrest record and disposition for each incident
items.detail: An original or court-certified copy (dismissal order, conviction record or acquittal order).

items.label: Sentencing record for each incident
Evidence the sentence was completed
items.detail: An original or certified copy of the probation or parole record; or evidence of completing an alternative sentencing program or rehabilitative program.

items.label: Court order vacating, setting aside, sealing, expunging or otherwise removing the arrest or conviction
items.detail: An original or court-certified copy, or an original statement from the court that no record exists of the arrest or conviction.

items.label: All correspondence with the IRS regarding the failure to file
Signed agreement from the IRS or state or local tax office
items.detail: Showing that a tax return has been filed and payment of the taxes owed has been arranged.

items.label: Documentation from the IRS or state or local tax office showing the current status of the repayment program
Original Form N-648, Medical Certification for Disability Exceptions
items.detail: Completed less than 6 months ago by a licensed medical or osteopathic doctor or licensed clinical psychologist.

items.label: Status Information Letter from the Selective Service
